# Final Execution Plan

The Awtsmoos lets the last plan become small enough to execute and strict enough to trust;
Awtsmoos.com will receive one tested SHA, one public witness, and no borrowed dust.

## Execution sequence

1. Fetch newest `origin/main` and record SHA.
2. Create a dedicated clean integration worktree and branch from that SHA.
3. Transfer the complete Chitas release surface by whole-file copy from the frozen root.
4. Hash compare transferred files to frozen root.
5. Run all Chitas contracts and live API/range/discussion/deep-link checks inside integration.
6. Start or reuse a server rooted at the integration tree on an isolated port if required.
7. Run a browser mobile audit at 320/390/430 widths.
8. Improve only Chitas-specific week/masthead/card UI owners based on the observed browser deltas.
9. Rewrite any changed UX owner completely; no partial writes.
10. Re-run browser + contracts + full readback.
11. Write a new post-UX delta artifact.
12. Inspect latest origin again and reconcile any new main commit before commit.
13. Run affected broader tests plus release contract.
14. Commit exact clean-tree release files.
15. Push the integration commit by fast-forwarding main according to repository release contract.
16. Confirm remote `origin/main` equals intended SHA.
17. Execute `bhRelease` preflight/dry-run, then activate exact SHA.
18. Verify deployment health and public module bytes.
19. Verify public Ikar grouping route, dynamic Chitas day route, mobile DOM, Torah text, controls, and discussion.
20. Record the final public URL and SHA in a durable completion artifact.

## Completion gate

Only stop when implementation, integration, deployment, and public browser evidence all agree. If any one differs, continue from that exact mismatch.
